Dr. Virginia Locke (known by friends and family as ‘Ginnie’) welcomes you to her practice.  Dr. Locke is a 1996 graduate of Buckeye High School.  She attended Centenary College in Shreveport and graduated with her B.S. in biology before attending LSU School of Dentistry and receiving her Doctorate of Dental Surgery in 2004.  Dr. Locke is a member of the American Dental Association and has taken a variety of continuing education courses to enhance her practice.  She has studied with the Misch Institute, and also completed the Garg continuum, focusing on implant placement and prosthodontic restoration, as well as traveling abroad for educational and mission purposes.

Dr. Locke married her husband Jeremy in 2000 and they have three children (Ella Kate, Emmarie, and Jake) who also attend Buckeye.  Dr. Locke is an avid outdoorsman who enjoys deer hunting and any type of fishing possible (especially largemouth bass and coastal saltwater fishing)!

Thank you for visiting our Locke Family Dentistry page!
